description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for displaying log messages. It implements the LogNode interface to receive log data, format it, and display it within the UI, supporting chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting and displaying log messages.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors initializing LogView with different context parameters.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and appends log data to the LogView, also forwarding to the next LogNode if linked.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper to append strings with delimiters if they are not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
